Maturity.info_phase: FinOps phases (Crawl, Walk, Run) determine your level of cloud practice evolution.
Maturity.info_VisibilityAndAllocation: Measures how well you are tagging and viewing your costs.
Maturity.info_UsageOptimization: Measures how much you are turning off or deleting idle/oversized resources.
Maturity.info_RateOptimization: Measures your reserved instance and savings plan coverage.
Maturity.info_ForecastingAndBudgeting: Measures the accuracy of your budgets vs actual spend.
Maturity.info_GovernanceAndAutomation: Measures how many automated policies you have active.

governance.tagInfoTooltip: Tag Governance allows you to enforce mandatory tags (e.g., CostCenter, Environment) across all subscriptions to improve cost allocation accuracy.
governance.tagInputTooltip: Type the exact name of the tag key you want to make mandatory.
